text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Crap, did I mess up!? Did I 
double-book myself!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The shopping district's passion, right? 
Like, hardcore tag, and getting called to 
the granny runway show... Plus there's 
Disco vs. Club, too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, or maybe we can just make it one 
big festival! Sounds fun! It's settled!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Palmer-chin's coming too?! 
Plus the swing old-timer and the cats 'n' 
dogs... Let's invite that alien washed up 
on the beach too!
